source.title: DHW Drinking Water and Private Wells hub (Idaho Certified Laboratories) + Drinking Water Testing and Certification + Free Private Well Water Testing via Idaho Health Tools
limitations: DHW Idaho Certified Laboratories table on the private-wells hub lists 8 labs (name, street address, city, phone) for finding a water testing laboratory near you; private-well sample acceptance is not stated per commercial row — marked unknown; call first.

Idaho Bureau of Labs is on that table and DHW promotes private-well testing through IBL citizen-science / submission forms plus Free Idaho Private Well Water Testing (Available Fall 2026) via Idaho Health Tools — treated as verified private-well paths; still call/confirm packages.

Idaho Health Tools product page retrieved 3 October 2026 printed *Currently sold out, additional tests will be available soon* and *Only one test kit per household can be ordered every five years.* — enrollment/fulfillment status not invented beyond printed wording; DHW hub titles the program Available Fall 2026.
About 30% of Idaho residents use private wells; private wells not regulated — as printed on DHW hub.
Test bacteria and nitrates once a year; other contaminants every 3 to 5 years — as printed on DHW hub.
Fees intentionally omitted from the table — confirm with the lab / agency.
Kansas KDHE AB Manager remains JS-only without a verified static export — skipped again.

verified_paths.name: Free Idaho Private Well Water Testing (Available Fall 2026) via Idaho Health Tools
verified_paths.notes: DHW Drinking Water and Private Wells hub titles Free Idaho Private Well Water Testing (Available Fall 2026) and directs residents to Idaho Health Tools to request a free testing kit. Contaminants named on the DHW hub include nitrate, fluoride, arsenic, lead, uranium, manganese, chromium, nickel, copper, zinc, selenium, cadmium, and barium. Health Tools product page retrieved 3 October 2026 printed Currently sold out, additional tests will be available soon and Only one test kit per household can be ordered every five years — confirm current availability on the official page. Contact EH@dhw.idaho.gov or 1-800-445-8647.

verified_paths.name: Idaho Bureau of Labs — private-well path via DHW certified list + IBL citizen-science / submission forms
verified_paths.notes: Named on DHW Idaho Certified Laboratories table (2220 Old Penitentiary Rd., Boise; 208-334-2235). DHW private-wells hub states private well owners utilizing IBL as their testing laboratory can participate in citizen science by granting permission on IBL submission form. Drinking Water Testing and Certification page: call 208-334-2235 with questions about sample submission to IBL; consult Sampling and Submission Guide; proper forms must accompany samples. Call/confirm packages and fees.
